body.name: validated capacity-search handle
body.construction: Apply the rational interval oracle to a fair dyadic branch-and-bound tree on \([-G,G]\). At depth \(d\), bisect every surviving interval, evaluate it at precision at least \(m_\epsilon+d\), retain a rational incumbent upper bound, and prune only boxes whose certified lower bound exceeds that incumbent. Stop no later than depth \(D_\epsilon\) after the full-level fallback partition has objective gap at most \(\epsilon\).
